Want clear answers and zero stress? Then this is your vacancy, more information below!What we offer- A starting salary of €14.99 per hour!- Complimentary fresh soup and fruit provided daily!- Shift allowances of 22.5% and 45%- Opportunities for career advancement!- A good travel allowance!- Meaningful work that directly supports hospitals!Who you areAs a production worker, you appreciate a welcoming workplace with clear structure and good communication. To start smoothly at Rentex in Leeuwarden, you meet the following requirements:- You speak and understand English or Dutch;- You are available for at least two days a week;- You are available for shifts starting at 06:00 or 15:00;- You have your own transportation to travel to Rentex;- You are at least 18 years old, in accordance with labor laws regarding these specific working hours;What will you doAs a production worker clean laundry at Rentex, your work is structured, predictable, and very important! Together with your team, you process clean linens and uniforms for hospitals across the Netherlands. You help sort fresh textiles, feed clean laundry into automatic folding machines, and hang garments onto scanning racks. Never done this before? No worries at all! Patient buddies will coach you on every task until you feel 100% confident. You work steady shifts between 06:00 and 23:00, and your supervisors are always nearby to answer your questions.Where will you workRentex in Leeuwarden is one of the largest and most reliable healthcare laundries in the country. As a demolition worker, you are responsible for carrying out demolition and clean-up activities safely and efficiently. Experience is not required; motivation and a practical attitude are most important.Your tasks include:- Demolishing walls, floors and other constructions using hand tools and small machinery- Cleaning and removing debris from demolition sites- Separating construction waste and materials according to safety regulations- Assisting colleagues during renovation and demolition projects- Loading and unloading materials and tools- Following VGM and safety instructions on-site- Keeping the workplace clean and organisedYou work in a 2-shift schedule:- Early shift: Monday to Friday from 06:00 to 15:00- Late shift: Monday to Friday from 15:00 to 00:00You receive an 18% shift allowance on top of your salary.For this position, it is important that you enjoy physical work and can work safely on construction and demolition sites.We ask the following:- You have an active and practical working attitude- You are physically fit and able to perform heavy work- You are willing to work in a 2-shift schedule- You understand basic safety and VGM instructions- You can work both independently and in a team- A driver's license B is an advantage- You have a good command of the English language
